name: GIC
coverage: Publicly disclosed GIC India investments and strategy across public markets, healthcare, hotels, infrastructure and technology-enabled businesses. GIC does not publish a complete India holdings register, so undisclosed positions are not inferred.
limitations: GIC explicitly says it does not report investment specifics except where legally required; this view is therefore selective rather than exhaustive.
Some investments are made through affiliates or platforms and the parent-level percentage may not be available.
A reported proposal or platform commitment is not presented as a completed purchase without adequate closing evidence.

companies.name: SAMHI Hotels platform
companies.relationship: Planned joint venture in which GIC would take 35% in three SAMHI subsidiaries operating four hotels.
companies.summary: GIC's hotel venture is structured around asset-level subsidiaries rather than a simple purchase of the listed parent, with capital directed to debt reduction and a Bengaluru development.
companies.thesis: India's travel, business and domestic leisure demand can support higher-quality branded hotel supply and operating leverage.
companies.risks: Deal completion, hotel cyclicality, leverage, asset-level ownership complexity and execution of new properties.

companies.name: Asia Healthcare Holdings
companies.relationship: Long-term platform investment with TPG; GIC announced an additional US$150 million in 2024.
companies.summary: AHH builds single-specialty healthcare platforms including Motherhood Hospitals, Nova IVF and AINU, giving GIC exposure to organised specialty care.
companies.thesis: Specialty healthcare can scale through focused brands, clinical capability and under-served demand.
companies.risks: Healthcare regulation, clinician capacity, integration and capital intensity.

companies.name: AIG Hospitals
companies.relationship: Reported potential investment alongside Novo Holdings and Axight; GIC's individual stake was not disclosed.
companies.summary: AIG Hospitals is reported to be in advanced discussions with GIC and other investors at a large private-market valuation.
companies.thesis: Specialty and multi-specialty hospital capacity remains a long-run structural need as insurance coverage and healthcare spending rise.
companies.risks: Reported status, valuation, regulatory process and lack of disclosed GIC allocation.

companies.name: Genus Power Infrastructures smart-metering platform
companies.relationship: GIC-backed platform partnership for smart-metering projects, historically announced with a large initial pipeline.
companies.summary: Smart metering combines infrastructure deployment with recurring service opportunities and supports India's power-distribution modernisation.
companies.thesis: Policy-led grid digitisation can create a large, multi-year deployment market.
companies.risks: Tender execution, working capital, receivables, regulatory changes and platform-level ownership opacity.

companies.name: India real assets and infrastructure portfolio
companies.relationship: Diversified investments across real estate, roads, infrastructure trusts and related platforms; individual positions are not fully disclosed.
companies.summary: GIC has invested in Indian public markets since the 1990s and expanded into private equity, real estate and infrastructure, using local partnerships across asset classes.
companies.thesis: Long-duration capital can benefit from urbanisation, logistics, roads, digital infrastructure and the formalisation of real assets.
companies.risks: Interest rates, leverage, construction delays, regulation and private-asset valuation transparency.

events.title: Hotel-platform proposal carried into the review period
events.detail: The joint-venture plan was announced in April 2025 and is carried as a dated existing proposal for this view.
events.qualification: This is not counted as a new purchase within the current review window.

events.title: Reported advanced talks for AIG Hospitals investment
events.detail: GIC was reported among investors considering a Rs 2,000–2,500 crore round with Novo Holdings and Axight.
events.qualification: No completed investment or individual GIC ownership percentage is verified in the report.

report.title: GIC in India
report.summary: GIC is a sovereign reserve manager with a deliberately long time horizon and a cross-asset India strategy. Its public material points to financial services, technology-driven businesses, healthcare, real estate and infrastructure, while its disclosures emphasise partnerships and portfolio-level returns rather than a complete list of individual holdings.

sections.title: Investment idea
sections.text: GIC looks for durable Indian growth through multiple asset classes: public equities, private platforms, real estate and infrastructure. Its India group coordinates the portfolio and local partners provide market knowledge and operating capability. The approach is patient-capital investing rather than a short-term public-market signal.

sections.title: Healthcare and hospitality
sections.text: The strongest disclosed operating examples are specialty healthcare and hotels. The AHH follow-on investment shows willingness to support a platform through multiple rounds, while the SAMHI structure shows preference for asset-level partnerships that can repair balance sheets and fund expansion. AIG Hospitals is a current reported opportunity, not a confirmed holding.

sections.title: Infrastructure and technology
sections.text: GIC's stated India strategy includes technology-driven businesses, real estate and infrastructure. Smart metering and real assets fit a thesis around formalisation, urbanisation and India's long capital-spending cycle, but the public record often does not identify precise legal stakes.

themes.name: Specialty healthcare
themes.case: AHH and the reported AIG discussions show a repeatable interest in healthcare platforms that can scale clinical capacity.
themes.watch: Execution, clinical quality, integration and valuation.

themes.name: Hotels and travel assets
themes.case: The SAMHI venture links GIC to India's expanding branded-hospitality supply and asset-level development.
themes.watch: Occupancy, pricing, leverage and completion of the JV structure.

themes.name: Digitised infrastructure
themes.case: Smart metering and real-asset partnerships align with long-run grid, urbanisation and infrastructure needs.
themes.watch: Tender economics, cash conversion and regulatory execution.
